# Applio — Free AI Resume Builder
# https://appliohq.com

## What Applio Does
Applio is a 100% free AI resume builder that helps job seekers build ATS-optimized resumes, tailor them to any job description, and get more interviews. Every feature is free — no credit card, no watermark, no paywall.

## Key Features
- 26 ATS-friendly resume templates (free, customizable)
- AI resume tailoring to any job description (grounded in real experience)
- Free ATS resume checker (0-100 score, matched/missing keywords, exact fixes)
- AI cover letter generator (tailored to job + resume)
- AI interview preparation (questions + STAR coaching)
- Job search & application tracker (Kanban)
- AI career coach (resume, strategy, salary negotiation)
- Salary insights by role & location (live market data)
- Skill Gap analysis (resume vs job posting)
- Brag Doc / Win Journal for performance reviews
- First 90 Days onboarding plan
- LinkedIn optimizer & personal site from resume

## MCP Server (Model Context Protocol)
- Endpoint: https://hireflow-api.pritamavuthu7.workers.dev/mcp
- Protocol: Streamable-HTTP (JSON-RPC 2.0)
- Public Tools (no auth): search_jobs, ats_score, extract_job_keywords, list_resume_templates
- Authenticated Tools (Bearer token): tailor_resume, generate_cover_letter, improve_bullets, interview_prep, career_coach
- Setup Guide: https://appliohq.com/connect

## Key Differentiators
- 100% free — no credit card, no watermark, no trial
- AI grounded in real experience (never invents jobs/numbers)
- Real ATS score (0-100) with exact keyword gaps
- ATS-first design — templates parse correctly
- All-in-one career toolkit (resume → interview → offer → onboarding)
